data.one_liner: Flutter plugin that embeds Plaid Link native SDKs for iOS, Android and Web.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart API to create a Plaid Link handler with a link token and open the Plaid Link flow. It wraps the native Plaid SDKs and forwards events back to Flutter.
use_when: You need to integrate Plaid Link for bank account linking in a Flutter app
You require native iOS/Android/Web Plaid experiences with token‑based flow
avoid_when: You don't need Plaid functionality or prefer a pure Dart solution
You cannot modify native project files (e.g., permissions, Gradle, Xcode settings)
strengths: Full native SDK integration on all platforms
Supports latest Plaid Link features like Identity Verification and FinanceKit
weaknesses: Only works with Plaid; not a generic banking SDK
No code‑generation or declarative UI helpers
data.setup_notes: Add NSCameraUsageDescription for iOS Identity Verification; add CAMERA, WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE, RECORD_AUDIO, MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS permissions to AndroidManifest; ensure minSdk >=21; include Plaid JS script on web; initialize with a server‑generated link_token
